            r["checks"]["mega_detail_ok"] = True

            with XtreamClient() as xt:

                        with c.stream("GET", player_api_url(target.origin),

                    "unsafe_api_base","no_imported_subscriptions"}:
        r["checks"]["reason"] = str(exc)
print(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True))
